rows.text: # Consequence measurement prediction — revision 1

Status: DRAFT, agent self-review in progress; no implementation or allocation.
SeamId: symbolic `seam/measurement-prediction` in existing SeamId family.
Version: `measurement-prediction/0.1-draft` (never an executable version string).
Architecture edges: Character Learning Evidence → belief/expectation authority;
retained belief → authorized later cognitive projection.
Owner: belief/expectation state authority, symbolic `authority/belief-expectation`.
Depends on: accepted M1/342, carriage337, diagnostic203, PRJ/IDN, nested projection,
ADAPT route/state-family declarations, WRT, cenc/1, ordering/0.2, trace/0.2 and the
memory successor's prefix-validated persistence discipline.
Supersedes: nothing. All frozen models and source contracts remain unchanged.
## Semantic purpose

Implement the target in CAMPAIGN2_MEASUREMENT_PREDICTION_RESEARCH_TARGET.md:
an exact-mean prediction of the next permitted reading of one declared channel.
Prediction is neither a remembered observation nor an authoritative present value.
Its exchangeable-reading hypothesis is a thin candidate, not a retention verdict.
It grants no calibrated uncertainty or causal/action-conditioning interpretation.
## Required phenomena

Thin belief application and later causal availability on the Campaign2 path;
the research target's five frozen comparisons. PHEN-LEARN's broader causal learning
and PHEN-REASON's downstream use remain separate qualification work. This seam
does not requalify or change PHEN-ADAPT, carriage or episodic memory.
## Domain and codomain

Application consumes exactly live MeasurementEpisodeLearningEvidence/342 schema1
produced by the registered M1 transition under measurement-episodic-memory/0.1-candidate.
Embedded337 and203 retain their exact accepted versions and bytes. 342 production
does not require successful episode formation; the application cannot read an episode.

The new application is separately registered on route/character-learning. It
emits no semantic output occurrence: its result is an exact StatePatch and existing
trace160 with input, actual reads and structural diff. Do not allocate an artificial
application-result ID when the scheduler event and trace already identify this work.

A later generated prediction-read opportunity produces exactly one symbolic
MeasurementPredictionReadout iff the addressed leaf exists; otherwise no semantic
output. Presence and absence each consume one fixed private runtime-ordinal slot,
as in the accepted recall control. No absent readout object or fake prediction is
published. This read is a capability witness at the cognitive boundary, not a claim
that complete workspace/appraisal has been implemented.
## Units, ranges, and applicability

First profile: exact existing diagnostic channel and unit/diagnostic-regulatory-level,
one observed subject, one projected character per admitted M1, and source points in
{k/10 | integer 0<=k<=100}. The unit is copied as an identity discriminator, not a
REG variable, dimension, conversion, reward scale or efficacy measure.

The immutable PredictionDefinition contains SourceChannelId, ObservedSubjectId,
UnitId and MaxEvidenceCount. First-profile MaxEvidenceCount=64. It is a laboratory
domain bound, not capacity, decay or a psychological forgetting law. Reaching the
bound with another fresh observation fails; no observation is silently discarded.
The profile fixes all four fields through committed model data. Other channels,
subjects, units, ranges or bounds require a newly reviewed profile.
## Registered ReadDomain and capability-limited projection
Application has exactly two authorized state projections:

1. The accepted nested M2 selector 342/2→337/2→203/2, then immutable IDN roster268/1
   and267/1, yielding qualified CharacterId. Admission precedes extraction and read.
2. One exact prediction leaf selected from that detached qualified subject and the
   registration's committed PredictionDefinitionId. No event-controlled full path,
   foreign character, global map enumeration or callback can select the leaf.

The composite target requirement is new contract data. Its symbolic fields are
SubjectAccessor, PredictionDefinitionId, TargetStatePathTemplate and OutputAccessor.
Construction binds it to exactly the application/read registration and sole leaf
pattern. DefinitionId uses the existing1027 family; it is not an occurrence.

The later read uses the cue's top-level ObserverId with accepted PRJ/IDN, then the
same composite target projection. Its cue DefinitionId must equal the one in the
registration before the prior leaf is read. Registry metadata supplies the safe
target, not runtime content resolution. Both projections record actual reads.
## Actual-read recording and derived-input provenance

IDN records its real roster path/source and accepted derived projection. The prior
belief access records the exact key, presence, complete leaf and direct accessor.
n is the cardinality of the returned EvidenceBasis; it is not a second state read
or a lookup in trace. No source reference can be dereferenced by this contract.
Zero source/REG/body/memory/value/habit/identity reads are admitted.

Read evidence must be captured from the actual returned operands, not reconstructed
by rereading state at finish. Consumer-returned invented read records are invalid.
## Authoritative StatePatch writes and sole MutationAuthorityId
One new physical leaf in logical belief/expectation family, on character-learning:

Key fields are required. CharacterId uses namespace1002 and the accepted character
qualification validator; DefinitionId uses1027, absent DomainValidator, plus exact
compiled definition membership. A definition identity does not grant content access.

Value: ExpectedReading reduced rational; EvidenceBasis nonempty canonical set of
existing CharacterEvidenceRef observation variants, cardinality<=64. No other
variant is admitted. ExpectedReading lies in[0,10]; its reduced denominator divides
10*n. These structural checks are necessary but do not prove historical derivation.

The root contains only the map above. Each entry is its own StatePath; no monolithic
root/map replacement. Sole authority is symbolic authority/belief-expectation in1025.
RemovalAllowed=false. Absent initial belief is required; initial authored means and
preseeded supports reject. A learned zero with nonempty basis is a present value.

Application returns exactly one set operation with the actual frozen prior as its
expected precondition, or expected absence on first application. Its changed path
and structural diff are exactly the derived target. No other family or target may
change. Evidence basis always gains a fresh member, so successful application always
changes state even when the forecast is numerically unchanged.
## Epistemic permissions and forbidden knowledge

Observer ownership comes only from PRJ/IDN. ObservedSubjectId is target metadata,
not cognitive owner. The exact target/source match is mandatory before belief read.
Raw203,337,OutcomeLearningEvidence270,AutomaticAdaptationInput, archived342 bytes,
caller-authored342 and valid-looking IDs cannot directly invoke application.
Only the registered live342 producer association may do so.

Existing SEM/EVID's consequence227→269→270 chain remains unchanged. This explicitly
admitted342 consumer is a consumer of the already accepted memory successor's
separate character-learning evidence type, not a new meaning for270.

No truth handle, R0, D, authoritative cause, another character's state, source trust,
confidence, appraisal, success expectation, reward or value judgment is obtainable.
The retained support references carry no payload-resolution permission.
## Preconditions

Exact model/profile, registration, producer event/bytes, occurrence role, source
version, observer/channel/subject/unit and point domain; successful PRJ/IDN;
exact target/read capability; valid prior leaf; new Observation reference absent
from its basis; cardinality below64. Distinct337 or342 wrappers around an already
counted observation do not make that observation fresh.
## Totality, typed failures, instant rollback, and failed-run behavior

No numerical overflow or machine wrapping: arbitrary-precision exact arithmetic.
Failures must use a committed typed owner, not a Boolean no-op. Existing substrate
failures retain their owning layer. Proposed new symbolic domain failures:
PredictionSourceMismatch, PredictionObservationAlreadyApplied,
PredictionEvidenceLimitExceeded. Their committed carrier/member placement is a
packaging gate, not a string chosen in implementation.

Invalid initial/model declarations fail before run creation. At runtime, admission
and source-domain checks precede target projection; target collisions precede prior
belief reads; prior validity/freshness/limit checks precede arithmetic and staging.
Any failure rolls back the whole instant's state, queues, allocators, outputs and
trace and marks Failed. A retained invalid leaf cannot be repaired by new evidence.
An invalid candidate must not be clipped into the domain.
## Exact transformation

Let x be the admitted203 point (equal interval endpoints); b its existing
CharacterEvidenceRef observation identity. If prior absent, next=(x,{b}). Otherwise:

This is exact equal nominal weight, not precision estimation. 203's precision=1 is
a source-admission constraint and never a formula operand. Source time is preserved
in its existing source record; there is no decay or timestamp-based learning rate.
The formula is permutation invariant for distinct points with unchanged membership;
proof is the independent sum/count oracle, not sorting IDs before an order-sensitive
update. Cardinality is not interpreted as independent evidence or certainty.
## Random addresses and distribution mapping

None. Zero draws; PERSIST-I remains deferred. A later dice-using profile must close
its RNG persistence obligation independently.
## Quantization and rounding points

None in the candidate. Reduced rational storage and intermediates under an explicit
new numeric-profile binding. numeric/exact-1 is not edited or broadened. The historical
quantizing estimate remains a separate control, not declared byte-equivalent.
## Canonical collection ordering and tie rules

cenc/1 orders support sets and map keys by canonical bytes. Duplicate support entries
are invalid. No occurrence ordinal affects a magnitude or a tie. A singleton target
collision policy forbids two applications to one exact path in one instant before
reading prior state, regardless of predicted numerical equality.
## Event phase and timing semantics

The successor M1 event still executes at130 and publishes exactly one342. Its model-
governed fanout adds one application at140 and one later read cue at T+1, phase40,
alongside the preserved memory child. The read cue contains only ObserverId and
PredictionDefinitionId. Its generation depends on live342, not application success
or presence; the whole instant must still commit before the cue becomes durable.
T+1 uses checked SimDuration arithmetic. Original input cannot contain either child.

At entry to140, gather all admitted applications, derive exact targets and reject
collisions. They read the same frozen pre140 state through their projections and
stage disjoint patches. The common view includes all successful work before140,
but none of that instant's ADAPT, episode or prediction writes. This preserves
ADAPT's frozen pre-adaptation semantics. IDN remains immutable.

No late application is admitted after the phase140 batch is sealed. No new handler
at140 may bypass the declared dispatcher. The application emits no child; later
read cues were already generated by M1. Phase150 remains nonschedulable.

The read at T+1 sees committed prediction from T, subject to its own IDN qualification.
It executes before any T+1 phase140 update. This first profile does not apply beliefs
at30 or depend on same-instant recognition. ORD-001 remains open and out of this
profile; adding immediate current evidence requires its resolution.
## Postconditions

One admitted fresh observation adds one support at one owned leaf and changes its
forecast by the exact formula. Formation ablation cannot block prediction. Prediction
ablation cannot block evidence, episode formation or its read opportunity. A later
read returns the exact committed leaf or honest absence through the exact authorized
path. No earlier record is rewritten by later learning.
## Invariants

Sparse unknown versus present learned zero; exact owner/definition target; role and
producer authentication; fresh observation support; finite nonempty basis; exact
mean domain; sole authority; character-learning route; no truth/trace lookup; frozen
same-instant prior; atomically committed state; no RNG or same-instant cognitive loop.
## Trace records and provenance

Use trace160's existing event, input, actual-read, StatePatch, diff, output and child
fields. Application source is342. The retained causal support is its nested existing
Observation reference, not a newly minted provenance graph. Immediate342→application
parent and historical observation supports are distinct relations.

The later read's source is the authenticated cue; its actual state read links it to
the retained prediction. Do not add a fake scheduler parent from the old application
to the later read: M1 generated that cue. Its readout contains a fresh readout ID,
the exact MeasurementPredictionKey and exact MeasurementPrediction value. No copied
Observation payload, REG handle, independent source hash or confidence field.

Restore requires original S0 and ordered inputs, exact admitted execution prefix,
whole-save equality at quiescence and preserved pending-child associations. Structural
range/role validation alone cannot prove that an arbitrary basis/mean belonged to
this character. Prefix validation proves the generative history without using trace
as a cognitive input or recomputing historical observations from current REG state.
## Candidate mechanisms and control implementations

Exact arithmetic mean candidate; last-reading and constant-gain-half controls;
read-only historical MEC-001 estimate with zero decay/unit weights and its actual
quantization. Independent direct sum/count oracle. MEC-002/006 remain explicitly
deferred beyond exact-point prediction. No historical code imported into src.
## Competing models / ablations

Application-disabled version has NoStateWrites, no prior-belief access and no patch;
it preserves source admission and subject qualification, M1 output and read cue.
Read-disabled version preserves cue admission/IDN and one private ordinal slot,
but no belief read or semantic output. These are separately committed semantics,
not arbitrary public runtime callbacks. Memory formation/read controls remain
independent, preserving the accepted separation experiment.
## Equivalence relation and tolerances

Exact canonical state/read/operand equality under named identity bijections.
Numerical predictions compare as reduced rationals, zero tolerance. Different
history trace orders are not equal; only the specified prediction and support-set
projection is permutation invariant. No universal equivalence to historical means.
## Proof obligations and executable tests
Freeze proposed PRED-A..P before implementation:

| Vector | Required witness |
|---|---|
| A | Absent prior versus learned zero; later authorized read distinguishes them. |
| B | Permitted5 versus51/10 intervention first changes the computed prediction. |
| C | Held-safe-input hidden-cause intervention changes no prediction operand. |
| D | Same multiset in different orders matches direct exact sum/count; last-reading and gain controls distinguish history dependence. |
| E | Raw/forged/archived/wrong-version/wrong-route inputs reject before projection. |
| F | Real PRJ/IDN maps distinct observer/character identities; foreign target blocked before prior read. |
| G | Wrong channel/observed subject/unit/bound/precision/missing input rejects at source admission. |
| H | Duplicate original Observation through another wrapper is not new evidence. |
| I | Exact target collision and late insertion reject before evaluation; independent targets see frozen prior. |
| J | Exact one-path patch/diff, all other targets/families byte-identical; wrong authority/spill mutant detected. |
| K | Evidence limit boundary and next observation failure; no clipping/forgetting. |
| L | Application ablation leaves evidence/episode/read opportunity intact but later prediction absent. |
| M | Read ablation cannot recover forecast from cue, episode, REG or trace. |
| N | Later failure rolls back application, all other staged writes and all pending/allocator/output/trace effects. |
| O | Whole-save prefix validation rejects forged mean/support/owner/cue; uninterrupted versus restore continuation exact. |
| P | Read at later phase40 reflects prior committed prediction, not its own instant's later140 update; no backward re-entry. |

These are FROZEN RESEARCH OBLIGATIONS, NOT PASSED. Pure numerical exploration is
not a pass of runtime vectors. Public exclusions and generic component positives
must be stated separately, especially for other owners/targets not in the first
closed model.
## Applicable Campaign 0 conformance vectors
## Known domain exclusions

All current-lane learning, bounds-only/missing observations, decay, general source
quality, trust, action contingency, person models, appraisal/reward/value/identity
learning, covariance, dynamic targets, cross-unit conversions, random choice and
lifelong unbounded support growth. Full-path Campaign2 completion remains open.
## Unresolved decisions

The semantic target/formula and finite profile above are ready for adversarial
component review. Whole shape awaits exact symbolic registration/role inventory,
new failure carrier placement, readout occurrence/output rule, private suppression
slot topology and successor profile/trace/persistence packaging. Those choices
affect authoritative output and cannot be left to implementation.
## Reopen conditions

A target needs action conditioning, immediate current learning, source quality,
censored evidence, calibrated uncertainty, forgetting, generalized source
aggregation, different unit/subject or an intervention outside the frozen profile.
Such work earns a new contract/profile; it does not silently reinterpret this mean.
## Change history

Revision1: inspected M1 reuse; consequence-only timing; explicit exact-mean
candidate and causal support; independent read opportunity; no new application
occurrence. Agent draft only; no external planning-agent verdict is claimed.
# Measurement prediction: autonomous whole-shape review
2026-09-09. **Agent self-review, not an external planning-agent verdict.**

Disposition: **SHAPE ACCEPT, bounded symbolic contract only.** Version
measurement-prediction/0.1-candidate. Runtime vectors PRED-A..P remain NOT PASSED;
separate allocation and complete model/profile materialization must precede
canonical implementation. No existing profile, corpus or allocation is changed.
## Reviewed authority and concrete findings

North Star's evidence-quality rule requires proposition-specific governed meaning;
it does not make an observation's precision into generic belief confidence. The
candidate predicts a later reading and deliberately provides no calibrated
uncertainty number. It earns only that stated thin prediction target, leaving
broader uncertainty/causal/action-belief obligations open. This is not a reduction
verdict and does not complete the belief topology or Campaign2.

CHARACTER_ARCHITECTURE sections3.3/4.2/14 distinguish evidence, belief, appraisal,
permitted learning and prediction discrepancy. The proposal preserves those edges:
live342 is evidence, the exact-mean leaf is a learned expectation, later authorized
read is a projection, and neither current truth nor REG can be read. Discrepancy,
success, valence, causal attribution and reward are not added to the evidence.

STATE_MODEL requires one authority per persistent leaf and typed learning input.
The new leaf uses only authority/belief-expectation and route/character-learning.
Memory formation and prediction are separate consumers of the same authentic342;
one does not depend on successful mutation by the other. The read has no learning
route and cannot become an implicit second evidence-production path.

The Campaign Plan permits a thin deterministic reference, but requires the full
causal path before campaign closure. A prediction readout is not a hand-authored
Reason Nucleus or an implemented workspace. Motives, reasons, retained dice and
identity, intent and execution remain required future work. No capability is
declared complete merely because this seam can later supply one operand.

DETERMINISTIC_SUBSTRATE permits exact rational representation. The historical
fixed-lattice policy does not override it; the current immutable numeric/exact-1
profile also cannot be broadened. Separate numeric binding is a packaging gate.
## Adversarial objections and resolutions

| Objection | Resolution and retained proof burden |
|---|---|
| Is this merely a copied historical measurement? | It predicts the next reading from multiple admitted supports; 0,10,10 yields20/3, distinguishing last-reading10 and gain-half15/2. This is an executed algebra distinction, not yet a public runtime witness. |
| Is sample count being called confidence? | No confidence/uncertainty field exists; count is only equal nominal averaging weight. Correlation remains unmodelled, not disproved. Future consumers cannot claim calibrated confidence from this contract. |
| Is historical generic estimation declared equivalent? | No. Actual historical quantization yields6666667/1000000 on that example. The preserved implementation is explicitly a control and remains unchanged. |
| Does prediction read hidden R0/D or infer them from a unit? | No. Source203's exact point is the sole scalar. The unit is an identity; there is no conversion or REG query capability. |
| Can the same Observation be counted through another wrapper? | Freshness is over the existing observation reference in the retained basis, not337/342 IDs. Must execute PRED-H through the actual boundary. |
| Can trace validate/serve the belief at runtime? | Runtime reads only the exact owned leaf. Restore's whole-prefix equality authenticates history but never exposes a trace lookup to cognition. |
| Does a target collide before owner identity exists? | No claim of that impossible order: IDN qualification derives the key first; collisions reject before prior prediction reads/evaluation. |
| Can a cue hide the answer? | Cue fields are only ObserverId and definition ID. Read ablation must prove no prediction can be reconstructed from it, episodes, REG or trace. |
| Does the cue acquire a fake occurrence/provenance identity? | No. Cue InputProjection is recorded, SourceRecordIds empty, true M1 scheduler parent preserved, actual belief read gives the state dependency. |
| Is present-zero collapsed with unknown? | No. Nonempty support makes learned zero a present leaf. Only genuinely unlearned initial state is absent. |
| Does another writer silently share belief state? | New ownership and exact patch/path equality are explicit; no memory/ADAPT authority expands. Their old profiles remain immutable. |
| Does140 learning decide ORD-001? | No. This profile uses no30 application and only reads the result at a later instant. Immediate current learning still requires ORD-001. |
## Shape completeness and scope

The reviewed composition is the research target, draft revision1 and symbolic closure
revision1, with the latter's failure/role/route/trace clarifications controlling the
earlier provisional names. All eleven symbolic records, the single genuine readout
occurrence family, fifteen stable member payloads, exact state/key/role semantics,
four new text failure alternatives, conditional read output, suppression/private
slots, and source-independent ablation opportunities are fixed in shape.

Generic multi-owner/multi-target positive controls remain required where the first
closed model excludes them. Public exclusion is not a positive witness. Likewise,
PRED-A..P is not passed by the four named/1,296 algebra cases. The historical
43-file/328-test suite pass preserves its control baseline, not the new seam.
## Accepted semantic version identifiers
These exact labels own semantics; they are not numeric allocations or active models:

- measurement-prediction/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-application-registration/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-read-registration/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-target-projection/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-opportunity/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-application-ablation/0.1-candidate
- measurement-prediction-read-ablation/0.1-candidate

Normal application and read ExecutingSeamVersion use the composed measurement-
prediction version. Disabled versions use their respective ablation identifier.
The stable SeamId remains seam/measurement-prediction. DefinitionVersion for the
prediction definition uses the composed version; the opportunity entry uses its
opportunity version. Registration rows use the existing registry/transition-registration
kind with their respective registration version. No original source version changes.
## Next gates

Separate append-only allocation review of exactly the symbolic surface. Then a
complete committed profile tuple, bundle, schema/role/state slots, numeric binding,
actual event/work-budget derivation and trace/save mapping. Only after those gates
may canonical implementation begin. Qualification requires the complete frozen
adversarial vector set. No external decision is required to continue that work under
the user's autonomous authorization.
# Measurement prediction — symbolic closure, revision 1

2026-09-09. Agent-authored proposal. **Not allocated or implementation-ready.**
Completes the registration/occurrence/stage proposals left open by
CAMPAIGN2_MEASUREMENT_PREDICTION_DRAFT.md; does not claim an external verdict.
All new names below are symbolic. Existing numbers identify reused contracts only.
## Exact symbolic records
Fields listed in schema order, all required. Record names allocate no numbers.

## Governing symbols and exact role ownership

Reused families: SeamId1036, TransitionKind1009, EventTypeId1001,
RegistryDefinitionId1027, RegistryKindId1023, MutationAuthorityId1025,
Campaign2StateFamilyId1031, leaf family1032, ProjectionAccessorId1028,
ObserverId1000, CharacterId1002, ObservationChannelId1005, ObservationUnitId1039.
Their accepted payload grammar is unchanged.
The symbolic stable members needed by this proposal are:

Existing accepted ResolvedCharacterSubject accessor and character-qualification
validator are reused. No replacement IDN accessor or validator is created.

Every new field of an identity type has its exact role. CharacterId and this first
profile's ObservedSubjectId use1002 with the accepted character qualifier;
ObserverId uses1000 with absent DomainValidator; channel1005 and unit1039 have absent
DomainValidator. The latter also receives exact diagnostic-member admission from

## Application registration and admission

The normal registration has exactly one342/schema1 input, authenticated registered
M1 producer, accepted immediate generated-child ingress276 at same DueAt/phase140,
empty OutputDefinitions, StateWrites322 naming only authority/belief-expectation
and logical belief/expectation family. It contains one exact M2 subject requirement
and one prediction-target requirement. Required subject path remains342/2→337/2→203/2.

ReadDomain contains the existing roster pattern and the one prediction-leaf pattern.
The target requirement binds the subject projection and registration's one compiled
definition ID to the exact key before a prior leaf can be read. It returns the
whole direct leaf/absence, not an arbitrary selector or derive callback.

The application-ablation registration uses the same record with a distinct semantic
version, NoStateWrites322, roster-only ReadDomain, empty target requirements and
empty output definitions. It still admits the real342 and performs IDN qualification.
It neither reads nor writes a prediction and emits no children or semantic output.
The opportunity producer remains M1. An ablated application is not a failed normal
application and does not make its model's initially empty belief state materialize.

Only the application joins the existing character-learning TransitionRoutes map;
M1 retains its accepted membership. The later read is a cognitive projection with
